successCriteria.description: PgBalanceRepository implements all six IBalanceRepository methods (findByEmployeeId, findByEmployeeIdAndLeaveType, findByEmployeeIdAndFiscalYear, create, update, deductDays) using parameterized queries against the `balances` table with snake_case↔camelCase row mapping

PgBalanceRepository.deductDays atomically decrements remaining_days, increments used_days, and sets status to 'exhausted' via a SQL CASE expression when remaining_days reaches ≤ 0 — all in a single UPDATE RETURNING statement

BalanceService implements all four IBalanceService methods: getBalance delegates to repo.findByEmployeeIdAndLeaveType, getBalances delegates to repo.findByEmployeeId, hasSufficientBalance returns true iff remainingDays >= requestedDays (false if balance missing), deductBalance throws BalanceNotFoundError when balance missing, throws InsufficientBalanceError when remainingDays < days, otherwise delegates to repo.deductDays

BalanceController exposes two handler methods (getBalance, getBalances) that extract params, delegate to BalanceService, and return 200 with the result or 404 when balance is null; all errors caught and returned as 500 with a generic error shape
balance.routes.ts exports a Fastify plugin function that instantiates PgBalanceRepository → BalanceService → BalanceController and registers the two GET routes

PgAuditLogRepository implements all three IAuditLogRepository methods (findByEntity, create, findAll) using parameterized queries against the `audit_logs` table with snake_case↔camelCase row mapping; findAll builds dynamic WHERE clauses from optional filters with indexed placeholders

Unit tests exist for PgBalanceRepository (mock pg Pool, test all six methods including deductDays exhausted-status transition), BalanceService (mock IBalanceRepository, test all four methods including error-throwing paths), and PgAuditLogRepository (mock pg Pool, test all three methods including dynamic filter combinations)

constraints: All database access must go through the repository layer — BalanceService and BalanceController must never call pool.query directly; they delegate to IBalanceRepository / IAuditLogRepository exclusively (GP-001)
All SQL queries must use parameterized placeholders ($1, $2, …) — no string interpolation of user-supplied values (HARNESS constraint: no-direct-db-outside-repository)

Repository implementations must map snake_case database columns to camelCase entity properties via a dedicated mapping function (mapRowToBalance, mapRowToAuditLog) — the entity interfaces use camelCase exclusively

The BalanceService.deductBalance method must accept a pre-calculated days: number — the calendar-days-inclusive calculation (endDate - startDate + 1) is the responsibility of the leave-request module, not the balance module [BINDING RULE from reconciled.json]

Domain error classes (InsufficientBalanceError, BalanceNotFoundError, AuditLogValidationError) must carry a `code` property for HTTP mapping — BalanceNotFoundError.code = 'NOT_FOUND', InsufficientBalanceError.code = 'INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE', AuditLogValidationError.code = 'VALIDATION_ERROR'
No `any` type — use `unknown` with type guards where needed (HARNESS constraint: no-any)
outOfScope: Registering balance routes in src/app.ts — this is deferred to a follow-up integration phase per ARCHITECTURE.md
RBAC enforcement on balance endpoints — auth middleware and requireRole guards are not yet implemented; the controller currently has no auth checks

Audit log writing from balance operations — GP-002 requires audit records for state-changing operations, but the balance module does not yet integrate with IAuditLogRepository; this is wired in Phase 3 (leave-request) where the orchestrating service owns audit logging

entityInvariants.invariant: remainingDays = totalEntitlement - usedDays must hold after every mutation. The deductDays operation must update both usedDays and remainingDays atomically in a single UPDATE statement. Status must transition to 'exhausted' when remainingDays reaches ≤ 0.

Every AuditLog record is immutable after creation — there is no update or delete method on IAuditLogRepository. The `changes` field captures a snapshot of what changed (Record<string, unknown>). Records are always returned ordered by created_at DESC.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns null when the balance row does not exist (caller must handle). The SQL CASE expression handles the exhausted transition; no application-level status check is needed.

Throws BalanceNotFoundError (code: NOT_FOUND) when no balance exists for the employeeId+leaveType pair or when repo.deductDays returns null. Throws InsufficientBalanceError (code: INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE) when remainingDays < days. Both errors extend Error and carry a `code` property for HTTP mapping.
Returns boolean — never throws. Returns false when balance does not exist or remainingDays < requestedDays. Returns true when remainingDays >= requestedDays.

Accepts optional filters object with entityType, performedBy, fromDate, toDate. All filters are optional and combined with AND. Returns empty array when no records match. Never throws for invalid/missing filters — filters are simply ignored if undefined.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: PgBalanceRepository must import and use the `pool` from `src/shared/db/connection.ts` — no other database connection or pool instance

Balance entity interface, IBalanceRepository, IBalanceService, and error classes (InsufficientBalanceError, BalanceNotFoundError) must match the definitions in balance.model.ts — all implementations import from this file
AuditLog entity interface and IAuditLogRepository must match the definitions in audit-log.model.ts — PgAuditLogRepository imports from this file
BalanceStatus enum values ('active', 'exhausted') must be imported from src/shared/types/index.ts — no hardcoded string literals for status values in repository or service logic

integrationPoints.why: balanceRoutes plugin must be registered via app.register(balanceRoutes) in a follow-up integration phase — currently only uptimeRoutes is registered
LeaveRequestService will consume IBalanceService.hasSufficientBalance and IBalanceService.deductBalance during submit/approve workflows, and IAuditLogRepository.create for audit trail entries
